Definition: adverb from G4253; prior, sooner:--before (that), ere.
BiblicalUsage: Prin means before, sooner, ere, and it marks the time before the thing. Peter quotes Joel that the sun shall be turned into darkness before the great day of the Lord come, and the nobleman begs Jesus to come down ere his child die.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that before is a word of mercy: God warns before he judges, and he comes before it is too late.
